variable_coverage.construction: Monthly stock return in calendar month t; the paper does not specify whether it is raw or adjusted.

Ln(fiscal-year-end market value of common equity in US$ millions), where MV = fiscal-year-end closing price (Compustat #199) × common shares outstanding (#25); annual input held across months, with a minimum four-month FYE-to-return-month gap.
Natural log of fiscal-year-end common book equity (Compustat #60) divided by market equity [fiscal-year-end price (#199) × shares (#25)]; exclude firms with negative book value.
Prior month stock return Ret(t−1). The source does not say whether raw returns include distributions or use an adjusted series.
Cumulative stock return from t−12 through t−2. Use the Table 5 note’s endpoint.
Cumulative stock return from t−36 through t−13, following Table 5’s selected definition; Section 3.2 instead says t−36 through t−12, so this source conflict is retained.

Annual operating accruals = [(Δ current assets − Δ cash) − (Δ current liabilities − Δ short-term debt − Δ taxes payable) − depreciation/amortization] / prior-year total assets. In Table 5, enter at 1-, 2- or 3-fiscal-year lag; treat missing short-term debt and taxes payable as zero.

NOA = [operating assets − operating liabilities] / prior-year total assets, where OA=total assets−cash/ST investments and OL=total assets−short debt−long debt−minority interest−preferred stock−common equity. Enter at 1-, 2- or 3-fiscal-year lag; missing STD/LTD/MI/PS are zero.
